class.name: PhysXFlowRenderEffect
class.description: A [CompositorEffect] that runs after transparent geometry and draws each [PhysXFlow3D] in the world with NVIDIA Flow's ray marcher, compositing the gas into the scene color and against the scene depth. With a [PhysXParticleFluid3D] drawn in [constant PhysXParticleFluid3D.RENDER_MODE_SCREEN_SPACE], the gas is marched against the depth with the liquid's surface in it: the fluid's own effect runs just before this one when both install themselves. [PhysXFlow3D] installs it by itself, so there's normally nothing to set up (see [PhysXFlow3D]). Adding one to your own [Compositor] is also fine, for example to control its order among your effects: it is then used as is and not added a second time. (The fluid's effect is then added after your effects, so a liquid draws over the gas instead.)

method.name: get_world_compositor
method.description: The [Compositor] [param world] renders with, which [World3D] doesn't expose to scripts. For diagnostics and tests.
